ValidationRule.description: Ensures NAS Case Customer IDs are for the correct Account. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab. Removed global service case record type Gitlab#29271
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Account.Name <> "", Customer_ID__r.IM_Account__r.Name <> "", Account.Name <> Customer_ID__r.IM_Account__r.Name, OR( AND($RecordType.DeveloperName = "NAS_General_Support_Case", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Void Case"))), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "CAC_Executive_Escalations", $RecordType.DeveloperName = "NAS_Recurring_Support_Case" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the Customer ID is associated to the Account
